scope: Validation-only original-batch CUDA replay; selected confusion matrices and boundary counts must match saved GPU reports. Not exhaustive visual review or new acceptance scoring.
selection: Per scene worst supported Wall/Fence and margin; also worst >=16px supported case per focus class and maximum Wall false-positive pixels per scene, additional cases deduplicated by image.
raw_verification: Selected target RGB/semantic/instance and every replay-batch RGB byte, plus bound inventory/index signatures; not a full raw-data re-audit.
